repos.name: xtool-org/xtool
repos.description: Cross-platform Xcode replacement. Build and deploy iOS apps with SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, macOS.
repos.one_liner: A cross-platform Xcode replacement enabling SwiftPM-based iOS development on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
bullets: Built using Swift and SwiftPM for native performance and cross-platform compatibility.
Provides a modular infrastructure for building and deploying iOS applications outside of the Apple-restricted ecosystem.
Ideal for CI/CD pipelines and developers looking to reduce reliance on proprietary macOS build environments.
Streamlines the development lifecycle by abstracting complex Xcode project configurations.
repos.img_alt: A screenshot of xtool being invoked from VSCode

repos.name: wheresryan22/anatomy
repos.description: A Claude Code skill that turns a technical idea into a detailed, interactive isometric figure of a real machine. It makes SVG with optional WebGL shaders and 3D, for docs, articles and landing pages.
repos.one_liner: A Claude Code skill that generates interactive isometric technical diagrams and 3D visualizations from text prompts.
bullets: Utilizes SVG, WebGL shaders, and 3D rendering engines to create high-fidelity technical documentation assets.
Functions as an AI-agent skill, integrating directly into Claude Code workflows for automated visual generation.
Automates the creation of complex system architecture diagrams for technical whitepapers and landing pages.
Reduces the manual design overhead for developers needing to communicate complex infrastructure concepts.

repos.name: yeyuxin777/baoyan-agent-benchmark
repos.description: Sprix AI at 屿智同行 × 保研岛 — an open-source benchmark for AI agents in Baoyan advising and application planning.
repos.one_liner: An open-source evaluation framework designed to benchmark the performance of AI agents in complex planning and advising tasks.
bullets: Python-based evaluation suite tailored for measuring agentic reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities.
Provides standardized metrics for assessing how well AI agents handle domain-specific advising and application logic.
Serves as a critical tool for developers building specialized agents that require high accuracy in decision-making.
Helps quantify the reliability of agentic workflows in high-stakes advisory environments.
repos.img_alt: Performance of agent configurations on graduate admissions tasks
repos.img2_alt: Two-stage evaluation within a single session

repos.name: arcboxlabs/arcbox-desktop
repos.description: Native macOS GUI for ArcBox — containers, VMs, and sandboxes at your fingertips. Open Source alternative to OrbStack.
repos.one_liner: A native macOS GUI for managing containers, VMs, and sandboxes as an open-source alternative to OrbStack.
bullets: Swift-based native macOS application providing a high-performance interface for virtualization management.
Simplifies the orchestration of local development infrastructure, including Docker-compatible containers and virtual machines.
Offers a lightweight, open-source alternative for developers managing complex local dev environments.
Enhances productivity by providing a centralized dashboard for resource-heavy containerized workflows.

repos.name: storytold/wordcraft
repos.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word in pure Rust
repos.one_liner: A clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word written entirely in Rust.
bullets: Developed in Rust, focusing on memory safety, performance, and cross-platform portability.
Represents a significant infrastructure project to recreate complex document processing software from scratch.
Demonstrates advanced document rendering and text-processing capabilities outside of legacy proprietary stacks.
Useful for developers interested in high-performance text-processing engines and modular software architecture.
